name: lizzard-ai-usage
description: Track Codex, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot usage in the VS Code status bar.

commands.title: AI Usage: Definir caminho do Codex CLI
AI Usage: Definir intervalo de atualização
AI Usage: Set GitHub Copilot Token
AI Usage: Clear GitHub Copilot Token
AI Usage: Definir Créditos Mensais do Copilot

aiUsage.codexPath.description: Optional Codex CLI executable path. By default, use the CLI bundled with the Codex extension or find codex on PATH.

aiUsage.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often to fetch usage limits from the selected AI source, in seconds. The default is 10 minutes.

aiUsage.copilotMonthlyCredits.description: Monthly GitHub Copilot AI credit allowance. Set this to the total shown in your GitHub plan; zero displays ? because the billing usage API does not return the allowance.
